notes: Ice chunk S: a faceted lump of pale cyan ice with frost glints. Refills O2 a little when collected. Frames are the piece turned [0, 90, 180, 270] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them wrap (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node.
